stemMd: How did the revised search system handle alternative spellings?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It labeled every searcher as mistaken.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It translated every query into a different language.

options.label: C
options.textMd: It redirected them to relevant entries.

explanationMd: The third paragraph explicitly states that alternative spellings were redirected rather than producing empty results. This design supports access without requiring all users to begin from one preferred form.

distractorRationale.a: The project avoided treating variants as errors.
distractorRationale.d: That is the outcome the redirection prevents.
distractorRationale.e: The words and variants remained documented.
